items.quotedText: When any new Sub-processor is engaged during the Term, and if the GDPR applies to the processing of Personal Data, Alaio will, at least 10 days before the new Sub-processor processes any Personal Data, inform Administrator of the engagement (including the name and location of the relevant sub-processor and the activities it will perform) by sending an email to the Notification Email Address. Administrator may object to any new Sub-processor by notifying Alaio promptly in writing within five (5) business days after receipt of Alaio notice. In the event Administrator objects to a new Sub-processor, Alaio will use reasonable efforts to make available to Administrator a change in the Services or recommend a commercially reasonable change to Administrator´s configuration or use of the Services to avoid Processing of Personal Data by the objected-to new Sub-processor without unreasonably burdening the User. If Alaio is unable to make available such change within a reasonable period of time, which shall not exceed thirty (30) days, Administrator may terminate the applicable Order with respect only to those Services which cannot be provided by Alaio without the use of the objected-to new Sub-processor by providing written notice to Alaio. Alaio will refund Administrator any prepaid fees covering the remainder of the term of such Order following the effective date of termination with respect to such terminated Services, without imposing a penalty for such termination on Administrator.
